title: College Self-Assessment Builder
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: A five-step self-assessment of majors, size, setting, culture, and cost that turns your answers into a ranked priority profile with dealbreakers.

learningObjectives: Students will prioritize their own college criteria across majors, size, setting, culture, and cost, and judge which criteria are dealbreakers and which are trade-offs.

controls: Major, size, setting, distance, and cost dropdowns
Load Marcus and Start over buttons

keyQuestions: What is the difference between a dealbreaker and a high priority?
Why does the profile warn you if you haven't talked with your family about cost?
Which of your factors could you trade away for a stronger fit on another?
commonMisconceptions: Cost can be figured out after you're admitted.
assessmentOpportunities: Students produce a ranked profile with no more than two dealbreakers and can justify each dealbreaker in one sentence.
